summary: This is an 8-K filing by Mid-America Apartment Communities, Inc. and its operating partnership MAALP, reporting entry into a $350 million unsecured delayed draw term loan agreement with KeyBank and other lenders. The facility is available for draws until December 21, 2026, matures November 15, 2030, and proceeds are for general corporate purposes including debt repayment. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation transaction.
